description: This file defines the OrderSearchCriteriaBuilder class, a builder for constructing OrderSearchCriteria instances with various search parameters related to medical orders within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: OrderSearchCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing OrderSearchCriteria objects with customizable search parameters.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient associated with the order search criteria.

methods.name: setVisit
methods.description: Sets the visit associated with the order search criteria (since version 2.7.0).

methods.name: setCareSetting
methods.description: Sets the care setting to filter orders.

methods.name: setConcepts
methods.description: Sets the collection of concepts to filter orders.

methods.name: setOrderTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of order types to filter orders.

methods.name: setAccessionNumber
methods.description: Sets the accession number to match orders.

methods.name: setOrderNumber
methods.description: Sets the order number to match orders.

methods.name: setActivatedOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Filters orders activated on or before the specified date.

methods.name: setActivatedOnOrAfterDate
methods.description: Filters orders activated on or after the specified date.

methods.name: setIsStopped
methods.description: Indicates if stopped orders should be included.

methods.name: setAutoExpireOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Filters orders auto-expiring on or before the specified date.

methods.name: setCanceledOrExpiredOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Filters orders canceled or expired on or before the specified date.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Filters orders based on their action.

methods.name: setFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Filters orders based on their fulfiller status.

methods.name: setIncludeNullFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Includes orders with null fulfiller status if set to true.

methods.name: setExcludeCanceledAndExpired
methods.description: Exclude canceled and expired orders based on this flag.

methods.name: setExcludeDiscontinueOrders
methods.description: Exclude discontinue orders based on this flag.

methods.name: setIncludeVoided
methods.description: Includes voided orders if set to true.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an OrderSearchCriteria object with the current parameters.
